topic: Credit cards: if you do not pay the full balance, interest is charged, and it can grow fast.

episode.title: Credit Cards: The Balance That Grows

shots.narration: A smaller credit card payment can leave a growing problem.
shots.scene: Bright 3D cafe, vertical 9:16 frame, blank credit card beside a gold coin pile, no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash recoils from the towering coin pile.
shots.mood: Wide eyes, raised eyebrows, playful surprise.

shots.narration: Kash wants to pay just part of her balance.
shots.scene: Clean cafe table with a blank credit card and scattered gold coins, no text or logos.
shots.action: Kash slides a small portion of the coins forward.

shots.narration: [surprised] Coin explains: leave some balance unpaid, and interest is charged.
shots.scene: Cafe tabletop with separated paid and unpaid coin groups, no text or markings.
shots.action: Coin points at the coins left beside the blank card.
shots.mood: Coin looks gently serious; Kash watches attentively.

shots.narration: These ten coins represent an example balance.
shots.scene: Bright cafe tabletop with exactly ten plain gold counters in two rows, vertical composition, no text.
shots.action: Coin presents the ten counters with an open-handed gesture.
shots.mood: Cheerful smile, clear lighting, orderly shapes.

shots.narration: Kash pays only part, leaving some balance behind.
shots.scene: Cafe tabletop with ten gold counters beside a blank credit card and an empty shallow tray.
shots.action: Kash slides five counters into the tray.
shots.mood: Focused expression, remaining counters clearly separated.

shots.narration: [sighs] Interest adds to that unpaid balance.
shots.scene: Cafe tabletop with five remaining gold counters beside the blank card, paid counters in a separate tray.
shots.action: Coin places an orange counter onto the unpaid pile.
shots.mood: Kash frowns slightly; the orange counter stands out clearly.

shots.narration: And that interest can grow fast.
shots.scene: Stylized cafe tabletop visualization, gold balance counters beneath orange interest counters, no numbers or text.
shots.action: The orange interest counters rapidly accumulate above the gold counters.
shots.mood: Playful alarm, widening eyes, brightly contrasting colours.

shots.narration: Coin points Kash back to the full balance.
shots.scene: Clean cafe table with the complete gold-and-orange balance pile beside a blank credit card.
shots.action: Coin sweeps one hand around the entire balance pile.
shots.mood: Encouraging smile, Kash's expression turns thoughtful.

shots.narration: [excited] Check your full balance today; next, let's picture interest growing.
shots.scene: Bright cafe table with a blank credit card and the complete balance pile, vertical 9:16 frame, no text.
shots.action: Kash leans closer to inspect the entire balance pile.
shots.mood: Calm curiosity, friendly smiles, warm afternoon light.

episode.endHook: Next, we'll make growing interest easier to picture.
episode.description: Coin helps Kash understand why paying only part of a credit card balance can leave a growing problem. Using a simple example, they show how interest adds to an unpaid balance. General money education, not personal financial advice.
